description: Claude Code and Codex (hook trusted) in the project scope: each gets its copy – the skill in .claude/skills and .agents/skills, the agent as .claude/agents/.local.helper.md and .codex/agents/.local.helper.toml, the rule as .claude/rules/.local.style.md and a section of .codex/skilletor-rules.md – the pointer block appended to the project's own AGENTS.md, a .gitignore block in .claude and in .codex, .worktreeinclude naming every root; no run warning; check, status, a second sync changes nothing; the CLI's status names both targets.
